about_the_game:
18 years ago, the invasion began. Thousands were hunted, captured and possessed. Now your training is complete and it’s time to fight back.

In Twins of Olus, you take control of Lions, an orphaned Uthran native and his spectral partner Creo as they emerge from years of hiding after an otherworldly force invaded their homeland. Using innovative dual character controls, you’ll hack and slash your way through hordes of creatures, solve puzzles, collect power ups and meet plenty of quirky allies that will help you answer many looming questions.

Who are these invaders? What do they want with the Uthran people? What are these massive machines that have been erected?

Through exploration, fast paced traversal and a little creative thinking, only you can uncover the intent and identity of the nefarious force pillaging your home world.

Control two characters in tandem to experience a co-op adventure as a solo player. Seamlessly swap between playstyles to make the most of either characters best attributes.

Travel together day and night uncovering alternative routes as the sun rises and sets on each region. Encounter curious and remarkable creatures who may aid or deceive you during the journey.

Dash, launch & jolt at high velocity to cover vast stretches of terrain. Activate spectral bridges shared between the living and the dead to reach places once forgotten.

Enlist a squad of potent creatures that will lend you their powerful combat enhancements. Gather rare materials along the way to unleash the full potential of their skills.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (4 * 1800) or equivalent; AMD Phenom II X4 965 (4 * 3400) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce MX 150 ( 2048 MB); Radeon R7 260X (2048 MB)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) or equivalent; AMD FX-8350 (8 * 4700) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 ( 2048 MB); Radeon RX 580 (8192 MB)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Twins of Olus is a vibrant action-adventure game that follows a young Uthran who is inexplicably tied to the spirit of an ancient warrior. Together they must defeat an unknown nefarious force that has invaded, corrupted and possessed everything in his once utopic world.
